$comment: Extends backup_trigger.json without modifying it. Records the full Gemma loader/scientific identity split. Frozen before any activation is computed.

supersedes.reason: v1.2.0 carried PRIMARY params_sha256 as null with status PENDING. An authoritative identity artifact cannot leave null the value that runtime verification must check against; promotion was correctly refused on that basis. v1.3.0 supplies it. NO CONFIGURATION CHANGES: same repository, revision, releases, layers, widths, architectures, hooks and tiers.

unresolved_fields.statement: No identity field in this artifact is null, pending, provisional or awaiting a value. Every field required for runtime verification is populated.

extends.mutability: backup_trigger.json is unchanged by this artifact.

oi3_release_weight_resolution.role: Records the OI-3 verdict DIFFERENT: the two Gemma Scope releases are distinct training outputs, not selective publication of identical weights. Non-gating. It changes no configuration, eligibility rule or threshold in this artifact; it converts an already-recorded prohibition from resting on an open possibility to resting on a demonstrated fact.

identity_field_semantics.$comment: These three fields are NOT interchangeable. Persisting any one alone loses information the others carry.

release.meaning: Selects the saes_map namespace inside sae_lens.
release.authoritative_for: which hook family, layer coverage AND SPARSITY-TIER COVERAGE the entry is drawn from
release.strengthened_by_OI_1: Release also determines WHICH TIERS EXIST at a given layer. The same layer publishes different tier sets in different namespaces, so release is load-bearing for availability, not only for naming.

loader_sae_id.rule: NEVER persist loader_sae_id without its release. The flat key is meaningful only RELATIVE to a namespace: the same string can exist in more than one release and resolve to different weights, OR EXIST IN ONE AND NOT THE OTHER. Storing the key alone yields an identifier that reads as complete while its meaning lives somewhere else.
loader_sae_id.precedent: Same defect class as feature_idx without sae_id, which the bundle contract already fixed by moving identity onto the target. An identifier that requires an out-of-band namespace to resolve is not an identifier.

scientific_sae_id.meaning: The repository subdirectory AND the scientific identity of the SAE.
scientific_sae_id.authoritative_for: every scientific record, run card, evidence artifact and published claim
scientific_sae_id.rule: Scientific records cite scientific_sae_id. loader_sae_id appears only in loading code.

PRIMARY.release_rationale: Layer 29 is not on the fixed 25/50/65/85 percent resid_post grid, so resid_post_all is the only namespace that publishes it.

BACKUP.params_expected_sha256_status: RECORDED by LA-C in 1.2.0, retained unchanged.
BACKUP.release_rationale: resid_post_all does NOT publish l0_medium at layer 24 at that revision; it publishes only l0_small and l0_big. resid_post is therefore the ONLY source for the canonical backup SAE. v1.1.0 recorded this as false on the incorrect premise that an on-grid layer makes -res merely the canonical option among two.

not_a_third_family.statement: The two release strings do NOT violate backup_trigger.json's prohibition on a third SAE family or layer.
not_a_third_family.reason: The prohibition guards against expanding the configuration space after observing results. Two configurations remain two regardless of how many training artifacts they draw from. Nothing was added.

superseded_reason.text: The release namespace is packaging that follows from layer coverage, not an additional family.
superseded_reason.why: OI-1 showed the namespaces publish different tier sets at the same layer, so they are not two views of one packaging. The conclusion survives; this premise does not, and a true conclusion resting on a false premise is how stale reasoning propagates.

release_namespace_divergence.$comment: The OI-1 finding, recorded as the primary fact it is rather than as a footnote to the backup configuration.
release_namespace_divergence.finding: At revision 4c419f1ba0be8b7754d4151d4f26c23b92a9029e, resid_post_all publishes only l0_small and l0_big at layer 24. l0_medium is absent from that namespace and exists only under resid_post.
consequences: The split release choice is NECESSARY, not cosmetic. Neither configuration could have been drawn from a single namespace.
PRIMARY and BACKUP are distinct SAE artifacts, differing in layer, sparsity tier and release namespace simultaneously.
Release is load-bearing for AVAILABILITY, not merely for naming.
what_is_established: The two configurations are distinct SAE artifacts.
l0_medium at layer 24 is unavailable in resid_post_all at this revision.

what_is_NOT_established.statement: Whether resid_post and resid_post_all represent DISTINCT TRAINING RUNS, or one set of runs published under two namespaces with different tier coverage.
what_is_NOT_established.why_it_is_open: Different published tier sets is consistent with BOTH explanations. Selective publication of a shared training run would produce exactly the same observation.
what_is_NOT_established.why_it_does_not_block: The prohibition below covers both explanations identically. Settling it would only sharpen how precisely the PRIMARY-to-BACKUP difference can be described; it changes no permitted claim.

depth_fraction_matching.statement: Depth fraction is the ONLY dimension along which the two models are matched.

sparsity_metadata.$comment: Raw per-SAE metadata, recorded separately per model. These are NOT two measurements of one quantity.

qwen.semantics: k is exact and enforced by construction: exactly k features are active on every token. It is a hyperparameter, not a measurement. It has no variance and no corpus dependence.

gemma.semantics: observed L0 is the average count of features exceeding their learned threshold, measured over a corpus. It is a point estimate of a random variable with per-token variance, and the corpus it was measured on is NOT our corpus.

non_equivalence.statement: Qwen k and Gemma observed L0 are NOT COMMENSURABLE. Their numeric ratio has no scientific meaning. RETAINED UNCHANGED from 1.1.0.
reasons: Different kinds of quantity: one is a fixed hyperparameter, the other an empirical mean.
Different statistical status: k is a constant with zero variance; observed L0 is a point estimate of a distribution.
Different reference corpus: the Gemma figure was measured on a corpus that is not ours and is not the corpus used anywhere in this protocol.
Different dictionary scale: Gemma width 16384 against Qwen width ~80K, so raw counts are not even on the same base.
non_equivalence.demonstration: Two equally defensible readings of the SAME two numbers disagree by a factor of five. Raw counts give 120/100 = 1.2. Density (L0/width) gives roughly 0.0073 against 0.0013, near 5.9. A quantity whose 'ratio' depends entirely on an arbitrary choice of normalisation is not a property of the configurations. It is an artifact of the arithmetic.

retracted_claim.text: constant 1.2x proportional sparsity match; neither matched comparison is confounded by sparsity
retracted_claim.where_it_appeared: v1.0.0 sparsity_pairing block and the PM report accompanying it
retracted_claim.why_wrong: The 1.2 ratio was computed from incommensurable numerators. No cross-model sparsity relationship was ever established, so none could be preserved.

derives_from: matched transformer depth fraction, within tolerance 0.02, verified above
independent validation of each side at its own configuration through its own gates
does_not_derive_from: any architectural correspondence between topk and jump_relu
matched_pair_eligibility.statement: A pair is eligible because both sides independently pass their gates at matched relative depth. EACH CONFIGURATION IS JUDGED ONLY BY ITS OWN INDEPENDENT GATES. Sparsity, namespace and artifact provenance play no role in eligibility and confer none.

prohibited_sparsity_claims.rule: NO cross-model sparsity claim of any kind is permitted.
prohibited_forms: any ratio between Qwen k and Gemma observed L0
comparable, similar, equivalent or aligned sparsity
sparser than, denser than, or any ordering of the two models by sparsity
normalising either quantity by width, layer count or anything else in order to compare them
asserting that a matched comparison is or is not confounded by sparsity
prohibited_sparsity_claims.permitted: Reporting each model's own sparsity metadata separately, labelled with its own quantity_type, with no relational statement between them.

within_model_exception.statement: A sparsity change is interpretable WITHIN one model, never ACROSS models.
within_model_exception.detail: Qwen k 100 -> 50 is a halving of a single commensurable quantity. Gemma observed L0 120 -> 60 is likewise commensurable with itself. Neither licenses any statement relating the Qwen change to the Gemma change.
within_model_exception.precedent: Identical in form to the standing dose rule: LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH are labels scoped to a single pairing and are never compared across pairings.

interpretive_limit_primary_to_backup.status: EXTENDED in 1.2.0 from two moving dimensions to three
interpretive_limit_primary_to_backup.statement: PRIMARY to BACKUP changes THREE configuration dimensions simultaneously inside Gemma, and two inside Qwen.

detail.gemma: layer 29 -> 24, observed L0 tier l0_big(120) -> l0_medium(60), AND release / training artifact resid_post_all -> resid_post

interpretive_limit_primary_to_backup.consequence: NO PRIMARY-to-BACKUP difference may be attributed individually to depth, to observed L0, to release namespace, or to training artifact. All of them move together and no design isolates any one.
interpretive_limit_primary_to_backup.acceptable_because: BACKUP IS A FALLBACK CONFIGURATION, NOT A CONTROLLED ABLATION. It exists to give the run a second chance at finding shared concepts, never to measure the effect of any parameter.
interpretive_limit_primary_to_backup.scope_note: This confound lives ENTIRELY in the PRIMARY-to-BACKUP contrast. It does not touch either matched cross-model comparison, since primary-primary uses one Gemma artifact against one Qwen artifact and backup-backup likewise. The matched comparisons remain internally clean.
prohibited_claims: the resid_post release is better than resid_post_all, or the reverse
the backup SAE is a better or worse instrument than the primary SAE
any statement attributing a PRIMARY-to-BACKUP difference to one of the changed variables

comparison_scope.cross_model_matched_comparison: PRIMARY-PRIMARY or BACKUP-BACKUP only. UNCHANGED by the OI-1 finding.
comparison_scope.reason: Mixed-depth cross-model comparison is a total confound. The OI-1 finding adds a mixed-artifact confound on top of it but does not change the ruling, which was already absolute.

runtime_loading.prohibited: Calling the stock sae_lens loader at runtime.
runtime_loading.reason: The stock loader performs an unpinned raw HTTP shape request and exposes no revision parameter. Two independent consequences: (1) on Tamia the compute nodes have no outbound internet, so the request fails outright; (2) anywhere it does succeed, it resolves against HEAD, so a recorded revision would be provenance the loader does not honour -- a pin that reads as a pin and is not one.
required_procedure: Materialise weights on the login node at the pinned revision 4c419f1ba0be8b7754d4151d4f26c23b92a9029e.
Record the SHA-256 of each downloaded tensor file.
At runtime, load from the local path only, with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1.
Verify tensor hashes at load. The revision is authoritative for WHAT WAS DOWNLOADED; it is not evidence that what is on disk matches it.
runtime_loading.rule: A recorded revision is trusted only where a hash check enforces it. Do not treat the string as the guarantee.
runtime_loading.params_rule: BOTH downloaded params files MUST hash to the values above. Mismatch on either is a HARD STOP, not a warning, and not a condition to be retried past. Verification is required at download AND at every load, because the recorded revision attests what was fetched, never what is on disk now.

non_authoritative_fields.$comment: Emitted by sae_lens but carrying no provenance. Must be LABELLED inline wherever they are persisted, not merely omitted from claims -- an unlabelled field sitting beside authoritative ones reads as authoritative.
non_authoritative_fields.rule: Never cite either in a run card, evidence artifact, or published claim as a property of the SAE or its training corpus.

open_items.original_question: Does layer 24 also exist in the resid_post_all release, and if so are its weights byte-identical to the resid_post copy?
open_items.finding: Neither anticipated branch. resid_post_all does not publish l0_medium at layer 24 at all; it publishes only l0_small and l0_big. The canonical backup exists solely under resid_post.
open_items.resolution: The split release is NECESSARY, not cosmetic. Recorded in release_namespace_divergence and reflected in configurations.BACKUP.release_is_forced, corrected from false to true.
Both configurations PASS the depth-fraction assertion. PRIMARY delta 0.010417, BACKUP delta 0.000000. See depth_fraction_matching.

open_items.question: Are resid_post and resid_post_all distinct training runs, or one set of runs published under two namespaces with different tier coverage?
open_items.verdict: DIFFERENT. layer_24_width_16k_l0_big hashes to 774f3026... under resid_post and ce4e0275... under resid_post_all. The releases are distinct training outputs, not selective publication of identical weights.
open_items.effect_on_this_artifact: NONE. The prohibition on attributing a PRIMARY-to-BACKUP difference to release namespace or training artifact was already written to cover both outcomes; it now rests on a demonstrated fact rather than an open possibility.
open_items.rejected_alternative: resid_post_all/layer_24_width_16k_l0_big is IDENTIFIED, AVAILABLE, AND NOT SELECTED. It must not be staged, substituted or reported. See the resolution artifact.

open_items_summary.statement: No open item and no unresolved identity field remains.

validation_rules: release, loader_sae_id and scientific_sae_id are all present or the record is invalid.
loader_sae_id must never appear in a persisted record without release in the same object.
scientific_sae_id must be prefixed by the hook-family directory implied by release: resid_post_all/ for -res-all, resid_post/ for -res.
A layer off the 25/50/65/85 percent grid requires the -res-all release.
Tier availability is namespace-dependent and must never be assumed. A tier present in one release may be absent from another at the same layer.
Every scientific record cites scientific_sae_id; loader_sae_id appears only in loading code.
context_size and dataset_path, wherever persisted, carry the literal label LOADER DEFAULT, NOT PROVENANCE.
Runtime loading is local-path only; a stock-loader call is a hard failure, not a fallback.

The PRIMARY params file must hash to 6bb44c8c68797942d097604bfd8df50f4865c86282e2c4667e364382ea26120e and the BACKUP params file to 2e5f3bc8edc5340ac101fe967f5b59d7a14b40c47315baf5a3446232cb2e799e; mismatch on either is a hard stop.
No identity field may be null, pending or provisional. A promotion gate must refuse an identity artifact that leaves unpopulated a value runtime verification depends on.

Qwen and Gemma sparsity metadata are persisted in separate objects, each labelled with its quantity_type. They may not appear as two values of one field, in one row, or under one shared key -- a shared field name asserts commensurability that does not exist.
